messages:
Alyssa: Evening handoff — starting 1769004321. Short summary: we saw repeated cache OOMs on kv-cache hostpool causing 503s from embed-service between 21:10-21:35 UTC. Mitigation done: scaled kv-cache replicas 3→7, disabled prefix caching on embed-service, restarted pods on node pool 'inference-az3'. Error rate down to ~0.8% now.

oncall-bot: ALERT: kv-cache OOM (rule kv_cache_memory_high) fired 21:12 UTC — 32 occurrences. Link: https://monitoring.redwood/alerts/kv_cache_oom

Sam: Thx. Any idea root cause? memory leak in cache or bad client keys?

Alyssa: Likely leak in recent LRU change (PR #4821). Reproducer: heavy embed churn + long seqs. Saw GC churn in pod logs: `HeapAlloc: 1.9Gi -> OOM`.

Diego: Can you paste the relevant kubectl commands you ran?

Alyssa: Sure:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/kv-cache --replicas=7
kubectl -n inference annotate deployment/embed-service rollback-needed=true
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/embed-service
```

Maria: I pushed a temporary config to disable prefix caching on canary: `CACHE_PREFIX_ENABLED=false` for embed-service-canary. Will monitor.

Sam: I'll own the postmortem. Alyssa — can you collect heapdumps & pod logs and drop in /incidents/kv-cache-oom? Also add which commit hash reverted.

Alyssa: On it. I ran `gcloud compute ssh` into node `inference-az3-2` and grabbed /var/log/containers/embed-service*.log and heapdump: s3://redwood-incidents/kv-cache-oom/1769004321/

Diego: For short term: suggest pinning fallback model to embed-small to reduce mem pressure when cache unhealthy. Ops runbook item?

Sam: Good call. I'll add to runbook and trigger an override route to fallback model when cache error rate > 2%.

oncall-bot: Incident update: 503s back to baseline at 21:40 UTC. SLA risk: low. Next notification scheduled in 30m.

Maria: No blockers from infra side. I'll keep canary for 1h then roll to prod if stable.

Alyssa: Next steps for followup
- Attach heapdumps + logs (done by EOD)
- Revert LRU change PR #4821 in embed-service (Sam to coordinate)
- Add circuit breaker to kv-cache client (Diego)
- Add alert threshold tweak + runbook link (Maria)

Sam: Thanks. I'll create the incident ticket and postmortem draft. Assigning owners: Sam (postmortem), Alyssa (artifacts), Diego (client CB), Maria (config + alerts).

Alyssa: Handing off to night oncall @Diego — pings if error rate climbs >1.5% or OOMs reappear. :thumbsup:

Diego: Got it. Taking over. Will watch memory and error metrics. :eyes:

Maria: Thanks team. Good handoff. :white_check_mark:
